input.content: Pattern: premature removal of dual-shape read fallback during online data migration (P1). A "cleanup" drops the legacy-shape branch from a reader while a bounded, ungated background migration is still in progress and a documented mixed snapshot is supported; the reader then raises (e.g. KeyError) on any unmigrated row and fails whole-list consumers. Check: repo contract (README) for "read both shapes until migration finishes", presence of legacy rows in fixtures, and whether tests cover legacy/mixed/partly-migrated states (implementation-shaped tests covering only the new shape won't catch it). Fix: keep fallback until migration completion is verified, then remove with contract/doc update. Seen in destinations reader.py address_of (2026-10-11).
